description_en: Queries the list of network access endpoints under an IDaaS EIAM instance
description_zh: 查询IDaaS EIAM实例下的网络端点列表
name: ListNetworkAccessEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。首次查询为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of rows per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network access endpoint. Valid values:

shared: shared network access endpoint.
private: dedicated network access endpoint.

Default value: private
parameters.help_zh:
网络端点的类型，取值可选范围：

shared：共享网络端点；
private：专属网络端点；

默认值为private
parameters.name: network_access_endpoint_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the dedicated network access endpoint. This parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared
parameters.help_zh: 专属网络端点连接的VPC ID。NetworkAccessEndpointType取值为shared时不生效
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The region of the VPC for the dedicated network access endpoint. The region must be one of the regions returned by the ListNetworkAccessEndpointAvailableRegions operation. This parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared
parameters.help_zh: 专属网络端点连接的VPC所属地域，该地域取值必须在ListNetworkAccessEndpointAvailableRegions接口中返回。NetworkAccessEndpointType取值为shared时不生效
parameters.name: vpc_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the network access endpoint. Valid values:
 
pending: pending initialization.
creating: being created.
running: running.
deleting: being deleted.

This filter parameter does not take effect when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared
parameters.help_zh:
网络端点的状态，取值可选范围：
 
pending：待初始化。
creating：创建中。
running：运行中。
deleting：删除中。

NetworkAccessEndpointType取值为shared时，当前筛选参数不生效
parameters.name: network_access_endpoint_status
